[English](README.md) | [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) [![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-2.32.0%2B-blue?logo=google&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.13%2B-blue?logo=python&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.python.org/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tests-Passing-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity/actions) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v0.6.0-orange?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity/releases)
--- ## Overview **Oh-My-Antigravity** is the premier multi-agent orchestration harness engineered specifically for **Google Antigravity 2.0**. Ported and redesigned from [`code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent`](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent), `oh-my-antigravity` transforms Antigravity into a coordinated software engineering team. It features a unified, zero-overhead Python lifecycle hook engine, strict role-based permission boundaries, and 11 specialized agent personas equipped with 47 turnkey domain skills. ### Key Pillars - **Conductor Mindset**: Main orchestrators (`sisyphus`, `atlas`, `prometheus`) direct architecture, maintain plans, and delegate tasks without polluting source code directly. - **Strict Role Permissions**: High-level orchestrators are blocked from mutating source code directly, while worker agents (`hephaestus`, `sisyphus-junior`) are prohibited from tampering with configuration manifests or rules. - **Zero-Overhead Hook Pipeline**: Built entirely on standard Python 3.13 libraries, hooks run synchronously with sub-millisecond overhead and zero runtime pip dependencies. - **4-Phase Verification Protocol**: Guarantees that code implementations are never marked finished until files are inspected, tests pass, QA verification is conducted, and exit gates are satisfied. --- ## Quickstart & Installation Choose one of three installation methods depending on your environment. ### Method 1: Official Antigravity CLI (Recommended) Install directly through the Antigravity plugin manager: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity.git ``` Verify installation: ```bash agy plugin list ``` --- ### Method 2: One-Line Automated Installer Run the automated installer script to verify prerequisites, install dependencies, and configure the plugin path automatically. #### macOS & Linux ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity/main/install.sh | bash ``` #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` Both installers automatically verify that **Python 3.13+** and **Git** are present before completing the setup. --- ### Method 3: Manual Installation (Git Clone) #### Global Installation (User Configuration) Deploy user-wide across all Antigravity workspaces: ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/oh-my-antigravity # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\oh-my-antigravity" ``` #### Workspace-Local Installation Deploy isolated to a single project workspace: ```bash git clone https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity.git /.agents/plugins/oh-my-antigravity ``` --- ## Architecture & Hook Engine Antigravity invokes `oh-my-antigravity` through a multi-phase interceptor pipeline configured in [`hooks.json`](hooks.json). Every hook is an isolated Python script reading JSON payloads from `stdin` and emitting validated directives to `stdout`. ### Lifecycle Phases 1. **SessionStart (`scripts/session_start.py`)**: - Executes once per conversation session upon initialization. - Evaluates workspace capabilities and recommends optimal tools (such as `codegraph_explore` when `.codegraph` and CodeGraph MCP are active). 2. **PreInvocation (`scripts/pre_invocation.py`)**: - Executes at the beginning of each user turn. - Enforces todo/plan continuation, agent reminders, keyword triggers, and dynamically mounts requested skills matching slash-command syntax. (`AGENTS.md` and behavioral rules are loaded natively by Antigravity). 3. **PreToolUse (`scripts/pre_tool_use.py`)**: - Intercepts mutating tool operations (`write_file`, `edit_file`, `write_to_file`, `replace_file_content`, `multi_replace_file_content`, `run_command`). - Enforces role-based permissions: orchestrators cannot edit source code directly; workers cannot modify plugin manifests or task states. 4. **PostToolUse (`scripts/post_tool_use.py`)**: - Fires upon completion of subagent invocations or file modifications (`write_file`, `edit_file`, `write_to_file`, `replace_file_content`, `multi_replace_file_content`). - Enforces the 4-Phase Verification Protocol, checks plan format compliance, validates source code comments via comment checker, and alerts on empty responses. 5. **Stop (`scripts/stop.py`)**: - Runs during session shutdown or task conclusion to clean scratch files, log session metrics, and enforce plan continuation. ### Hook Interception Lifecycle ```mermaid flowchart TD SessInit([Session Start]) --> SessStart[SessionStart Hook] SessStart --> DetectEnv[Probe CodeGraph & Session Context] DetectEnv --> User([User Prompt / Turn]) User --> PreInv[PreInvocation Hook] subgraph PreInvPhase [Phase 1: PreInvocation Dynamic Context] PreInv --> SkillMount[Detect Slash Triggers & Auto-load Skills] SkillMount --> PlanCont[Enforce Todo / Plan Continuation] PlanCont --> UsageRemind[Agent Usage & Inactivity Reminders] end UsageRemind --> AgentDecision{Agent Selects Action} AgentDecision -->|Calls Tool| PreTool[PreToolUse Hook] subgraph PreToolPhase [Phase 2: PreToolUse Security Gate] PreTool --> RoleCheck{Role Permission Check} RoleCheck -->|Orchestrator editing source| DenyTool[Block: Delegate to Worker] RoleCheck -->|Worker tampering configs| DenyConfig[Block: Config Protection] RoleCheck -->|Permitted Action| ExecTool[Execute Native Tool] end DenyTool --> AgentDecision DenyConfig --> AgentDecision ExecTool --> PostTool[PostToolUse Hook] subgraph PostToolPhase [Phase 3: PostToolUse Validation] PostTool --> VerifyCheck[4-Phase Verification Protocol] VerifyCheck --> CommentCheck[Comment & Docstring Checker] CommentCheck --> EmptyCheck[Empty Response & Drift Detection] end EmptyCheck --> NextAction{Task Complete?} NextAction -->|Iterate / Delegate| AgentDecision NextAction -->|All Goals Met| StopHook[Stop Hook / Session Finalize] StopHook --> FinalResponse([Deliver Verified Result]) ``` ### Orchestrator-Worker Delegation Model ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as Developer / User participant Orch as Orchestrator (Sisyphus / Atlas) participant Spec as Specialist (Explore / Librarian) participant Worker as Worker (Hephaestus / Sisyphus-Jr) participant Hooks as Lifecycle Hooks Engine User->>Orch: Submit Goal / Issue Request Hooks-->>Orch: PreInvocation (Inject Context, Rules, & Plan State) rect rgb(240, 248, 255) note over Orch,Spec: Phase A: Discovery & Research Orch->>Spec: invoke_subagent(Explore / Librarian) Spec-->>Orch: Return Symbols, File Paths, and Documentation end rect rgb(255, 250, 240) note over Orch: Phase B: Plan Formulation Orch->>Orch: Construct Structured Todo / Plan Tasks end rect rgb(245, 255, 245) note over Orch,Worker: Phase C: Delegation & Implementation Orch->>Worker: invoke_subagent(Hephaestus: Implement Task 1) Worker->>Hooks: PreToolUse (write_to_file / replace_file_content) Hooks-->>Worker: Gate Passed (Worker Role Permitted) Worker->>Hooks: PreToolUse (run_command: tests & linters) Hooks-->>Worker: Gate Passed Worker-->>Orch: Task 1 Completed with Diff & Test Evidence end rect rgb(255, 240, 245) note over Orch: Phase D: Verification Gate Hooks-->>Orch: PostToolUse (Verify Diff & Evidence Protocol) Orch->>Orch: Phase 1-4 Verification (Confirm Tests Pass) end Orch->>User: Deliver Production-Ready Result & Changelog ``` --- ## Agent Roster `oh-my-antigravity` bundles 11 specialized agent personas, organized into three distinct tiers: Orchestrators, Workers, and Research Specialists. | Agent | Type / Role | Model Tier | Description | Permitted Tools Scope | |---|---|---|---|---| | **`sisyphus`** | Lead Orchestrator | `inherit` | Primary workflow coordinator. Plans, breaks down epics, delegates tasks to workers, and tracks completion. Antigravity System Tools & Extended Specialists | Command | Skill | Description | |---|---|---| | `/antigravity-hooks` | `antigravity-hooks` | Guide and best practices for creating, configuring, and testing Antigravity hooks. | | `/antigravity-subagents`| `antigravity-subagents`| Blueprint for subagent definitions, YAML frontmatter, tool whitelists, and lifecycle states. | | `/lsp` | `lsp` | Language Server Protocol diagnostics, symbol navigation, and rename verification. | | `/lsp-setup` | `lsp-setup` | Language server configuration and installation across 20+ language environments. | | `/rules` | `rules` | Behavioral rule injection engine and workspace configuration inspector. | | `/init` | `init` | Bootstraps project root `AGENTS.md` instruction indexes for AI engineering teams. | | `/init-deep` | `init-deep` | Generates hierarchical multi-level `AGENTS.md` architecture guides. | | `/call-atlas` | `call-atlas` | Direct invocation trigger routing execution tasks directly to Atlas orchestrator. | | `/call-prometheus` | `call-prometheus` | Direct invocation trigger routing architectural planning to Prometheus. | | `/coding-agent-sessions`| `coding-agent-sessions`| Searches and reconstructs past agent transcripts, session IDs, and context logs. | | `/security-research` | `security-research` | Multi-agent vulnerability hunting, threat modeling, and exploitability verification. | | `/tech-debt-audit` | `tech-debt-audit` | 9-dimensional technical debt assessment producing prioritized remediation ledgers. | | `/omomomo` | `omomomo` | Easter egg module celebrating oh-my-opencode roots and architecture history. | --- ## Configuration & Customization ### Plugin Manifest (`plugin.json`) The plugin manifest declares metadata loaded by Antigravity: ```json { "name": "oh-my-antigravity", "version": "0.6.0", "description": "The ultimate agent orchestration harness for Google Antigravity 2.0, ported from oh-my-openagent.", "logo": "assets/logo.svg" } ``` - **`name`**: Unique plugin identifier. - **`version`**: Semantic versioning of the installed package. - **`description`**: Summary displayed in Antigravity plugin listings. - **`logo`**: Path to the vector brand emblem (`assets/logo.svg`). ### Lifecycle Routing (`hooks.json`) Configures which lifecycle events and tool matchers trigger interceptor scripts: ```json { "hooks": { "SessionStart": [ { "type": "command", "command": "uv run python ./scripts/session_start.py", "timeout": 5 } ], "PreInvocation": [ { "type": "command", "command": "uv run python ./scripts/pre_invocation.py", "timeout": 8 } ], "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "^(write_file|edit_file|write_to_file|replace_file_content|multi_replace_file_content|run_command)$", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "uv run python ./scripts/pre_tool_use.py", "timeout": 5 } ] } ], "PostToolUse": [ { "matcher": "^(invoke_subagent|write_file|edit_file|write_to_file|replace_file_content|multi_replace_file_content)$", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "uv run python ./scripts/post_tool_use.py", "timeout": 5 } ] } ], "Stop": [ { "type": "command", "command": "uv run python ./scripts/stop.py", "timeout": 5 } ] } } ``` --- ## Contributing We welcome contributions from the community! Check out our comprehensive [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide for details on: - Setting up the local environment with `uv` and Python 3.13. - Running test suites: `uv run pytest scripts/tests/` - Running linters and formatters: `uv run ruff check scripts/` - Authoring custom subagents and defining YAML frontmatter. - Creating modular skills and adhering to standard library runtime constraints. --- ## Acknowledgments & Credits `oh-my-antigravity` is derived and ported from the outstanding work on [`oh-my-openagent`](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) created by [@code-yeongyu](https://github.com/code-yeongyu). # Release Notes: oh-my-antigravity v0.6.0

We are pleased to release **oh-my-antigravity v0.6.0**! Building on `v0.5.0`/`v0.5.1`, this release aligns the hook engine, agent definitions, and Antigravity skill guides with **Google Antigravity `v2.34.0`**, modernizes injected hook messages from deprecated `ephemeralMessage` to `systemMessage`, enriches `HookContext`, fixes `EditErrorRecoveryHook` file unlocking in production `hooks.json`, and binds continuation hooks strictly to active Boulder plans.

---

## 🌟 What's New in v0.6.0

### 1. ⚡ Hook Engine Modernization (`systemMessage`, `HookContext`, & `EditErrorRecoveryHook` Fix)
- **Migrated Deprecated `ephemeralMessage` → `systemMessage`**: Updated all 6 production hook emitters (`CodegraphRecommendationHook`, `SubagentSkillAutoloaderHook`, `AgentUsageReminderHook`, `CompactionTodoPreserverHook`, `InitProjectDirReplacerHook`, `KeywordDetectorHook`, and `TodoContinuationEnforcerHook`) to emit `{"systemMessage": {"systemMessage": ...}}` per the official Antigravity Hooks contract.
- **Fixed `EditErrorRecoveryHook` Production Unlock Matcher**: Added `view_file`, `view_file_outline`, `view_code_item`, and `read_file` to `PostToolUse.matcher` in `hooks.template.json` and portable `hooks.json` so locked files actually unlock when inspected after an edit failure.
- **Enriched `HookContext`**: Added `workspace_paths`, `transcript_path`, `artifact_directory_path`, `invocation_num`, and `execution_num` fields to `HookContext` (`scripts/hooks/models.py`) and populated them cleanly in `HookEngine.build_context`.
- **Boulder Session Binding (`v0.5.1`)**: Scoped `StopPlanContinuationHook`, `CompactionTodoPreserverHook`, and `TodoContinuationEnforcerHook` to active `.omo/boulder.json` plans bound to the current conversation.

### 2. 🤖 Agent Frontmatter & Antigravity `v2.34.0` Docs Alignment
- **Clean Static Agent Frontmatter**: Removed redundant runtime-only `enable_mcp_tools: true` from all 11 agent profiles (`agents/*.md`), retaining `inheritMcp: true` and `inheritCustomizations: true`, and added a regression check in `test_release_readiness.py`.
- **`/antigravity-subagents` Guide Refresh**: Updated coverage to `v2.34.0` (including `browser` host input lock protections), added a `Tool Alias Reminder` note, and aligned the `atlas` example with `agents/atlas.md`.
- **`/antigravity-hooks` Guide Refresh**: Removed the duplicated `PostInvocation` section, clarified top-level named hook groups and committed portable `hooks.json`, and synchronized Section 4.1 `HookContext` / `BaseHook` contracts with `scripts/hooks/models.py` and `engine.py`.

### 3. 📦 Release, Installers & Verification
- **Version & Asset Sync**: Bumped `plugin.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `assets/banner.svg`, `README.md`, `README.zh-TW.md`, `install.ps1`, and `install.sh` to `v0.6.0`, updated Antigravity README badges to `2.32.0+`, and synced `scripts/verify_assets.py` to `47 Bundled Skills`.
- **Full Verification**:
  - `uv run pytest scripts/tests/`: **226 passed**
  - `uv run ruff check scripts/`: **0 errors**
  - `uv run python scripts/verify_assets.py`: **All SVG/XML assets compliant**
  - `agy plugin validate .`: **47 skills, 11 agents, 1 hooks validated**

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HengWeiBin/oh-my-antigravity/compare/v0.5.1...v0.6.0
